label: sec:cohomological-defect-preamble
html: Although the Frobenius trace \int_A \colon A \to \mathbf{1} is globally non-degenerate on the algebra object A, its restriction to the maximal ideal \mathfrak{m}_p at a singular branch point z = 1 acquires a nontrivial local cohomology group H^1_{\mathfrak{m}_p}(A). Localized matter states arise precisely as generators of this cohomological defect: the unit particle state is the fundamental class in local cohomology, its topological charge is quantized by the residue pairing, and its worldline in the contact three-manifold is a Legendrian knot transverse to the contact distribution.
